## MOCK TEST WORKFLOW - NEVER USE FOR PRODUCTION
This workflow does not contact Meta. It creates a fake Instagram message ID, then stores the outbound AI reply and handoff result in Supabase so the database and admin UI can be tested before Meta access arrives.

Configure only Webhook Header Auth, Supabase API, OpenAI API, and Runtime Configuration. Keep the production workflow separate and inactive.
